test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.

B. Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds.

C. It also helps in healing resentments and hurt.

D. But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships.
solution:
The correct answer is '**BDCA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence B** will be the starting line as it contains the main idea of the parajumble i.e. Emotional sharing.
 
• However, **Sentence D** states that sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships. So, **D** will follow **B**.
 
• Further, **Sentence C** states that it also helps in healing resentments and hurt and **sentence** **A** states that shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships. So, **A** will follow **C**.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds.
 
• **D**: But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships.
 
• **C**: It also helps in healing resentments and hurt.
 
• **A**: Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Emotional sharing builds strong and lasting bonds. But sharing laughter brings joy and freshness to relationships. It also helps in healing resentments and hurt. Thus, shared laughter is one of the most effective tools in maintaining healthy relationships.*
